links.outcome: Response consistency across two repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Chatbots changed responses between iterations in 5.4% (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), 6.5% (ChatGPT-4o), 8.8% (ChatGPT-4o-mini), 13.8% (Copilot), and 18.5% (Gemini) of cases.
links.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet demonstrated superior consistency, changing responses in 5.4% of cases between the two iterations, compared to ChatGPT-4o (6.5%), ChatGPT-4o-mini (8.8%), Copilot (13.8%), and Gemini (18.5%).

links.outcome: Self-reported confidence (0-10) versus accuracy of chatbot answers
links.effect: Confidence was high for all models (8.2-9.0) while scores ranged 0.54-0.84. Lower-scoring models reported somewhat lower confidence, but Gemini (0.54) still reported 8.2 ± 1.6.
links.quote: A self-reported confidence in answering the questions was 9.0 ± 0.9 for Claude 3.5 Sonnet followed by ChatGPT-4o (8.7 ± 1.1), compared to ChatGPT-4o-mini (8.2 ± 1.3), Copilot (8.2 ± 2.2), and Gemini (8.2 ± 1.6, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance, confidence, and consistency of five LLM chatbots on questions from the European Diploma in Radiology (EDiR) examination without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
